paite: Huai thilte nung in, "Abram, lau ke'n, kei na phaw leh na kipahman thupitak ka hi,” chi in Abram kiang ah mengmuhna in TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
heading: Abram Toh Pathian Thukhun
english: After these things Yahweh’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”

paite: Abram in, "Aw, Toupa PATHIAN, bang na hon pe dia, ta nei lou a ka om na mu a, ka goukempa lah Damaskas a Eliezer ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: Abram said, “Lord Yahweh, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”

paite: Abram mah in, "Ngai in, chi lah na hon suahsak kei a; en in, ka inn a piang pen mah ka gouluahpa hong hi ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: Abram said, “Behold, you have given no children to me: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”

paite: "Ngai in, huai mi na gouluah ding ahi kei. Nangmah gil a hong gah ding ngei, na gouluah ahi zaw ding,” chi in akiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: Behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”

paite: Amah inpua ah apikhia a, "Van lam en inla, aksite na simtheihleh sim him in," achi hi. Amah mah in akiang ah, "Na suante huchibang ahi ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So your offspring will be.”

paite: Ama'n TOUPA agingta a, huchi in ama'n huai adiktatna in asehsakta hi.
english: He believed in Yahweh, who credited it to him for righteousness.

paite: Akiang ah, "Hiai gam na luah ding a hon pe ding a Kaldaite khua Ur a kipan hon pikhia TOUPA ka hi," achi hi.
english: He said to Abram, “I am Yahweh who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”

paite: Ama'n, "Toupa PATHIAN aw, ka luah ding chih, bangchi in ka theithei dia?" achi hi.
english: He said, “Lord Yahweh, how will I know that I will inherit it?”

paite: Ama'n, akiang ah, "Bawngla kum thum a upa, kelpi kum thum a upa, vakhu leh vapalnou hon la in," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”

paite: Huai teng ahon la a, alaitak ah aphelkhap chiat a, aphel khat, aphel khat lam doh in akoih chiat a; vasate bel aphelkhap kei hi.
english: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.

paite: Sasial ne vasate'n saluangte tung abohsuk chiang un Abram in ana hawlkhe zel hi.
english: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.

paite: Ni tum ding a akisak lai in, Abram a-ihmu hithit hi. Ngai in, amial a mial, thil mulkimhuai petmah in amah hon khuh hi.
english: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.

paite: Hiai thilte nung in Pathian in Abram kiang ah, "Na suante amau gam hilou ah mikhual in a-om ding ua, a-nna uh asepsak ding uh, chih teltak in thei in. Kum zali sung hihgentheih in a-om ding uh.
english: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.

paite: A-nna uh asepsak nam uh ka vaihawmkhum ding hi. Huai khit chiang in thil tampi nei in ahong paikhe ding uh.
english: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;

paite: Nang na pipute kiang ah lungmuangtak in na pai ding a; na lu a kelsam pou vek in ahon vui ding uhi.
english: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.

paite: Himahleh, Amorte khelhnate akim nai louh ziak in, suan lina ah hiai ah ahong pai nawn ding uh," achi hi.
english: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni tum a, khua ahong mial in, ngai in, haltuina mei khu lunglung leh meisel kuang luahluah, huai sa kiphelkhapte kal a paipai ahong om hi.
english: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.

paite: Huai ni mah in TOUPA'N Abram toh thukhun bawl in, "Hiai gam, Aigupta lui a kipan lui lian, Euphrates Luipi pha in na suante kiang ah ka peta," achi hi.
english: In that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

paite: Kente, Kenizte, Kadmonte,
english: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,

paite: Hitte, Perizte, Rephate,
english: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,

paite: Amorte, Kanaante, Girgaste leh Jebuste toh leng ka pe lai hi, chi in Abram toh thu akhungta hi.
english: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”
